# Seemara

> Seemara is an AI company for Indian businesses, founded by Mamta More. It builds custom AI systems for small and medium businesses (SMEs) in India and runs two brands: Aha Frames, an animation and e-learning studio also founded by Mamta More, and Kaizen, an AI ad-creative product.

Key facts:
- Founder: Mamta More (founder of Seemara and of Aha Frames)
- Website: https://seemara.com/
- Contact: mamta@seemara.com
- Serves: small and medium businesses in India, such as D2C brands, clinics, restaurants, retail, coaching and education, real estate, agencies and manufacturing
- Offerings: custom AI systems; Aha Frames (https://ahaframes.com); Kaizen (https://seemara.com/kaizen.html)

## What Seemara builds
Seemara picks one repeated workflow, builds an AI layer around it and connects it to tools the business already uses (WhatsApp, website, CRM, spreadsheets, ecommerce, ad accounts, documents). The six systems clients ask for first:
- WhatsApp lead agent: collects requirements, qualifies leads, answers basics, nudges follow-ups
- Sales follow-up system: lead scoring, reminders, proposal drafts, personalised follow-ups
- AI marketing engine: campaign ideas, scripts, posters, captions, Meta-ready ad copy
- Customer support agent: answers questions using the business's products, policies and rules
- Catalog and product visuals: listings, catalog images, offer creatives, content variants
- Internal knowledge agent: one place for staff to ask about processes, products and training

Process: map the workflow, build a focused prototype, connect the tools, improve with feedback.

## Aha Frames
Aha Frames is Seemara's animation and e-learning studio, founded by Mamta More. It makes 2D and 3D animation, e-learning and SCORM courses, and animated ads and reels for learning and marketing teams. A first 2D video takes about two weeks. It works in English and ten Indian languages (Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia), checked by native speakers. Website: https://ahaframes.com

## Kaizen
Kaizen is Seemara's AI ad-creative product. It builds a brand memory from a business's website, catalog, photos, old campaigns and conversation, then turns a business goal into reels, posters, captions, scripts and Meta-ready ad copy. It creates one sample first, learns from feedback, then scales. Page: https://seemara.com/kaizen.html

## Articles by Mamta More, founder of Seemara
- [Introducing Aha Frames, Seemara's animation and e-learning studio](https://seemara.com/blog/introducing-aha-frames.html): Seemara has launched Aha Frames, an animation and e-learning studio founded by Mamta More. It makes 2D and 3D video, e-learning and SCORM courses, and animated ads and reels.
- [Where an Indian small business should start with AI](https://seemara.com/blog/where-indian-smes-should-start-with-ai.html): A practical guide to choosing the first AI project for an Indian SME: pick one frequent, repetitive, measurable workflow instead of a transformation programme.
- [What a WhatsApp lead agent does for an Indian SME](https://seemara.com/blog/whatsapp-lead-agent-guide.html): How a WhatsApp lead agent qualifies enquiries, answers the basics and makes sure every lead gets a follow-up, plus what to connect and which rules to respect.
- [Why animated training works for frontline teams](https://seemara.com/blog/animated-training-videos-for-frontline-teams.html): Why animation and short e-learning lessons suit frontline training: showing what can't be filmed, many languages, consistent messages and SCORM-ready courses.
- [Why most AI-made ads look generic, and how brand memory fixes it](https://seemara.com/blog/brand-memory-ai-ads.html): AI video tools can produce polished ads that still miss the product, the buyer and the goal. Brand memory gives the model the context it lacks. Here's how Kaizen uses it.
- [How Seemara builds a custom AI system, step by step](https://seemara.com/blog/how-seemara-builds-custom-ai.html): The four steps Seemara follows to build a custom AI system for an Indian business: map the workflow, build a focused prototype, connect the tools, and improve with feedback.
